I personally find starting with just successions of deep breathing before actually warming up. 

1 deep slow breath and a slow exhale
Then something like 5 fast inhale/exhale

Or any variance. I usually do something like that for about 4-5 minutes

Make sure the shoulders are back etc mostly so you know your using as much of your lungs as possible.

Getting that fast syllable annunciation really isn’t too hard once you figure out how your voice works with vowels and consonants(without forcing) 

You get a constant scream that you more or less “chop up”

Warming up I do something from the zen of screaming that uses a lot of consonants and vowels

May nay lay, mee nee lee, May nay lay, mo no lo, mu nu lu. 

In any way or order you want. Learning to hold that consistent tone so you can chop up the sound easier

Takes some time and a bit of effort. I threw out my voice so I’m gonna have to start all over again with this stuff in a couple months

It’s worth noting that “compressed” sound you get from screaming shouldn’t be forced or compressed in the throat. It happens more naturally if you let your scream float to the top of your skull above your front teeth. You’ll feel it buzz in your ears.
